heading: Monday, July 22, 2024
topLine: Team Numina wins the first AI Mathematical Olympiad Progress Prize.

items.headline: Team Numina wins the first AI Mathematical Olympiad Progress Prize
items.summary: Team Numina won the first AIMO Progress Prize, a Kaggle competition run with XTX Markets funding in which open models solved olympiad-style problems with numerical answers. The team received $131,072, and the prize was presented at IMO 2024 in Bath. Rankings came from the competition's private leaderboard, and winners had to publish their code, data and model weights.
